entries.title: Qwen Cloud Hackathon submission deadline
entries.summary: The active submission period runs through 2026-07-09 14:00 PT, with an internal KST freeze target before 2026-07-08.
entries.long_form: RuleMemory should keep this deadline active and trigger stale checks before final package freeze. The KST internal deadline is tracked separately to avoid timezone drift.

entries.title: MemoryAgent is the primary track
entries.summary: RuleMemory targets the MemoryAgent track because it persists contest rules, preferences, stale assumptions, and source provenance across sessions.
entries.long_form: The demo should show memory improving decisions across two sessions: first by ingesting official rules, then by detecting stale assumptions and producing a readiness packet with source hashes.

entries.title: Qwen workspace API proof
entries.summary: The operator-provided workspace MaaS OpenAI-compatible endpoint returned HTTP 200 for both model listing and a minimal qwen-plus chat completion.
entries.long_form: Use the workspace-specific OpenAI-compatible base URL when running smoke tests. The previous default DashScope endpoint produced invalid_api_key responses and should not be treated as the active route for this key.

entries.title: Next package step
entries.summary: Proceed from credential validation to live RuleMemory seed entries, public package checklist, README packaging, and demo proof capture.
entries.long_form: The highest-impact next Qwen work is no longer credential debugging. It is creating a judge-readable package where Qwen model usage is central and the memory loop produces practical readiness artifacts.
